Constructs domain Waypoint instances along interpolated circular arc trajectories.

class scaralang.core.service.compiler.motion.arc.builder.arc_waypoint_builder.ArcWaypointBuilder[source]¶

Bases: object

Constructs domain Waypoint instances along interpolated circular arc trajectories.

It defines:

methods:
build_waypoints - Builds interpolated arc coordinates as domain waypoints.
build_waypoints(*, arc_points: Sequence[ArcPoint], target_z: float, speed: float, context: ScaraCompilerContext) → tuple[Waypoint, ...][source]¶

Builds interpolated arc points as domain waypoints.

Parameters:

  • arc_points – Sequence of ArcPoint coordinate objects.

  • target_z – Target vertical elevation coordinate in mm.

  • speed – Effective feedrate speed in mm/s.

  • context – Active compiler context with orientation state.

Returns:

Tuple of generated Waypoint instances.

Exceptions:

None.
